lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਇਆ ਮਿਟੀ ਅੰਧੁ ਹੈ ਪਉਣੈ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaaiaa mitee a(n)dh hai paunai puchhahu jaai ||
lines.translation: The body is merely blind dust; go, and ask the soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਉ ਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hau taa maaiaa mohiaa phir phir aavaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The soul answers, "I am enticed by Maya, and so I come and go, again and again."

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਤੋ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਜਿ ਰਹਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak hukam na jaato khasam kaa j rahaa sach samaai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I do not know my Lord and Master's Command, by which I would merge in the Truth. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੋ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਧਨੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: eko nihachal naam dhan hor dhan aavai jaai ||
lines.translation: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the only permanent wealth; all other wealth comes and goes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸੁ ਧਨ ਕਉ ਤਸਕਰੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਈ ਨਾ ਓਚਕਾ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: is dhan kau tasakar johi na sakaee naa ochakaa lai jaai ||
lines.translation: Thieves cannot steal this wealth, nor can robbers take it away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਜੀਐ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਜੀਐ ਨਾਲੇ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu har dhan jeeai setee rav rahiaa jeeai naale jaai ||
lines.translation: This wealth of the Lord is embedded in the soul, and with the soul, it shall depart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈਐ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪਲੈ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: poore gur te paaeeai manamukh palai na paai ||
lines.translation: It is obtained from the Perfect Guru; the self-willed manmukhs do not receive it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਖਟਿਆ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa jinhaa naam dhan khatiaa aai ||2||
lines.translation: Blessed are the traders, O Nanak, who have come to earn the wealth of the Naam. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਤਿ ਵਡਾ ਸਚੁ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: meraa saahib at vadaa sach gahir ga(n)bheeraa ||
lines.translation: My Master is so very great, true, profound and unfathomable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh jag tis kai vas hai sabh tis kaa cheeraa ||
lines.translation: The whole world is under His power; everything is the projection of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਧਨੁ ਧੀਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee paaeeai nihachal dhan dheeraa ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, the eternal wealth is obtained, bringing peace and patience to the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭੇਟੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੂਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirapaa te har man vasai bhetai gur sooraa ||
lines.translation: By His Grace, the Lord dwells in the mind, and one meets the Brave Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਰਾ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: gunava(n)tee saalaahiaa sadaa thir nihachal har pooraa ||7||
lines.translation: The virtuous praise the ever-stable, permanent, perfect Lord. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਪਾਪ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhrig tinhaa daa jeeviaa jo har sukh parahar tiaagade dukh haumai paap kamaai ||
lines.translation: Cursed is the life of those who forsake and throw away the peace of the Lord's Name, and suffer pain instead by practicing ego and sin.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh agiaanee maaiaa mohi viaape tinh boojh na kaaee paai ||
lines.translation: The ignorant self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in the love of Maya; they have no understanding at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਓਇ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਏ ਪਛੁਤਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: halat palat oi sukh na paavahi a(n)t gae pachhutaai ||
lines.translation: In this world and in the world beyond, they do not find peace; in the end, they depart regretting and repenting.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee ko naam dhiaae tis haumai vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, one may meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and egotism departs from within him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਆਇ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jis poorab hovai likhiaa so gur charanee aai paai ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes and falls at the Guru's Feet. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖੁ ਊਧਾ ਕਉਲੁ ਹੈ ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh oodhaa kaul hai naa tis bhagat na naau ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh is like the inverted lotus; he has neither devotional worship, nor the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਉਪਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakatee a(n)dar varatadaa kooR tis kaa hai upaau ||
lines.translation: He remains engrossed in material wealth, and his efforts are false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਭਿਜਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਫੀਕਾ ਆਲਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis kaa a(n)dar chit na bhijaee mukh pheekaa aalaau ||
lines.translation: His consciousness is not softened within, and the words from his mouth are insipid.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਧਰਮਿ ਰਲਾਏ ਨਾ ਰਲਨੑਿ ਓਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਸੁਆਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi dharam ralaae naa ralanhi onaa a(n)dar kooR suaau ||
lines.translation: He does not mingle with the righteous; within him are falsehood and selfishness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੈ ਬਣਤ ਬਣਾਈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਡੁਬੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਤਰੇ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak karatai banat banaaee manamukh kooR bol bol dube guramukh tare jap har naau ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Creator Lord has arranged things, so that the self-willed manmukhs are drowned by telling lies, while the Gurmukhs are saved by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਵਡਾ ਫੇਰੁ ਪਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin boojhe vadaa pher paiaa phir aavai jaaee ||
lines.translation: Without understanding, one must wander around the cycle of reincarnation, and continue coming and going.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਨ ਕੀਤੀਆ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur kee sevaa na keeteeaa a(n)t gaiaa pachhutaaee ||
lines.translation: One who has not served the True Guru, shall depart regretting and repenting in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanee kirapaa kare gur paaeeai vichahu aap gavaaee ||
lines.translation: But if the Lord shows His Mercy, one finds the Guru, and ego is banished from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਉਤਰੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: trisanaa bhukh vichahu utarai sukh vasai man aaee ||
lines.translation: Hunger and thirst depart from within, and peace comes to dwell in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa sadaa saalaaheeai hiradai liv laaee ||8||
lines.translation: Forever and ever, praise Him with love in your heart. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੂਜੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: j satigur seve aapanaa tis no pooje sabh koi ||
lines.translation: One who serves his True Guru, is worshipped by everyone.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਉਪਾਵਾ ਸਿਰਿ ਉਪਾਉ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabhanaa upaavaa sir upaau hai har naam paraapat hoi ||
lines.translation: Of all efforts, the supreme effort is the attainment of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੀਤਲ ਸਾਤਿ ਵਸੈ ਜਪਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar seetal saat vasai jap hiradai sadaa sukh hoi ||
lines.translation: Peace and tranquility come to dwell within the mind; meditating within the heart, there comes a lasting peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਖਾਣਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੈਨਣਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਡਾਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit khaanaa a(n)mrit painanaa naanak naam vadaaee hoi ||1||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Amrit is his food, and the Ambrosial Amrit is his clothes; O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, greatness is obtained. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਏ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਿਖ ਸੁਣਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: e man gur kee sikh sun har paavahi gunee nidhaan ||
lines.translation: O mind, listen to the Guru's Teachings, and you shall obtain the treasure of virtue.
